purpose: Canonical activation signatures for cross-thread SOAiaCore commands.

rules.behavior: Review the available thread and extract high-density language candidates into the SOAiaCore Canonical Language Bank.
Run the active objective under OBSERVE → UNDERSTAND → RESOLVE → DEMONSTRATE with autonomous recovery, correlated human tasks, and evidence-based closure.
Activate the end-to-end manufacturing model covering demand, planning, materials, capacity, production, quality, release, inventory, distribution and cost.

uniqueness_rule: No two canonical entries may share the same normalized activation_signature with different semantic_domain values.
